limitations: 52 synthetic known engineering queries; metrics averaged over 44 answerable queries only.
Qrels are not exhaustive or independently expert annotated.
Existing real embeddings are replayed, with real Chroma retrieval and existing scoring code rerun; no live embedding API calls.
Small corpus; no large-scale ANN performance claim. No generation or RAGAS evaluation.
No neighbor expansion, matching the existing retrieval evaluation. Local replay times do not measure online latency.
Synthetic developer-visible engineering dataset; no clinical efficacy or independent expert gold.
Contract pass differs from feasible full goal completion; unknown remains in denominator.
No cross-layer score; no replacing primary results with best repeated trial.
Private embedding cache is not bundled; historical configured-model runner needs local prerequisites.
